name: UCI Condition Monitoring of Hydraulic Systems

name: Multisource Urban Water Distribution Network dataset
sensor_types: SCADA flow/pressure-derived anomaly scores + pumping station energy + groundwater/surface temperature
target_ground_truth: fault_d7: binary leak proximity label (+-7 days around confirmed leak event from PTIS maintenance system)
applicability_to_moskollektor: high - closest domain match found: real municipal utility network with verified leak ground truth and SCADA+environmental features

name: NIST Smoke Alarm Performance Data (TN 1947)
volume: 457 smoke-box experiment files + 90 room experiment files; TSV; 1s resolution
sensor_types: optical transmittance/obscuration; ionization MIC current; CO; temperature; RH; thermocouples

applicability_to_moskollektor: medium - real lab-confirmed physical alarm-response ground truth; useful for validating what a genuine confirmed smoke event looks like vs our literal-only Неисправен signal
